name: Hamilton — CMHC average rent, two-bedroom rental condominium apartment, October 2025
description: Survey average monthly rent for two-bedroom condominium apartments rented out by their owners, Hamilton CMA, October 2025 (CMHC Rental Market Survey, condominium component). Used in the investment screen because investor-owned condos are the stock a buyer would rent out.

attributes.notes: October 2024: $2,509; October 2025: $2,831 (quality 'c', good). Rental-condo vacancy rate October 2025: 1.2% (quality 'a'). No year-over-year % stored because CMHC publishes no same-sample estimate for condos.

sources.title: Rental Market Survey Data Tables, Hamilton CMA, 2025 (Table 4.1.3)
sources.methodology: CMHC Rental Market Survey (condominium apartment component), October 2025: condominium apartments rented by their owners; quality grades a–d.

limitations: Condominium rental survey covers fewer units than the purpose-built survey; quality grade may be lower. Survey average across sitting tenants, not an asking rent. Average, not median.
